Authentic, Flavorful Bun thit nuong
Sep 2025 • Friends
If you’re in Saigon and craving authentic flavors, this place is a must-try. This spot serves one of the best bun thit nuong in town—perfectly grilled pork, smoky and tender, paired with fresh herbs, crunchy pickled vegetables, and silky vermicelli. The fish sauce dressing ties everything together with just the right balance of sweet, sour, and savory. Portions are generous and satisfying, yet still light enough for a hot day. The place is simple and unpretentious, but the food speaks for itself. A true local gem I’d happily come back to again and again.

Excellent Banh Thit Nuong!
Jan 2019 • Solo
This restaurant is definitely off the beaten path. It’s about a 10 to 15 minute walk from Bui Vien Street in an area that is tourist free. Mostly locals eat here, with the occasional tourist foodie in search of something authentically Vietnamese. The menu is limited, as is seating and atmosphere. But the food is delicious! I had the Banh Thit Nuong, which is a bowl of: rice noodles, herbs, cut up meat spring rolls, BBQ pork, beef and peanuts. The food is fresh and delicious, and they are constantly cooking fresh items all day. The price was under $2 USD, and you are definitely full after the meal. My Vietnamese friends love this place, so you know it must be good... 👍
